budget_lineage: All added qualification work and scoring is charged to the original selected expert-reference envelope, with actual resource observations required. Main source searches/refits remain unchanged.
mandatory_fields: fit/development trial/bin/unit support descriptors and disjointness
all required search rows and original selection rules
native development metric type, denominator and source-split identity
difficulty facts with selection optimism and no assessment lineage
complete required reference coverage and unresolved evidence
decision: Convergence/domain/source completeness and declared ancestry are prerequisites. Record weak/negative development evidence without requiring neural superiority. Missing/unscorable required evidence blocks this fixed campaign, never changes its roster. No positive effect threshold or fresh574 competence is inferred.
comparability: A signed paired development contrast is allowed only for existing predictions with identical fit/development support, units, bins and metric convention. Native R4/R5 fold-mean scores and different R8 support are labeled separately; do not rank or pool them against D0 as a fair cross-method comparison. No extra unselected fold-control grid is implied. The full same574 comparison remains post-barrier E15/E16.
